scientific_integrity: The complete all-height least-volume enclosing ellipsoid formula and its -1/d threshold are prior work of Michael J. Todd (1982); the present claim is solely the strict excess-volume monotonicity and dimensional asymptotics proved from that formula.
scientific_limitations: One halfspace-truncated Euclidean ball in dimension at least two. Derivative and dimensional asymptotics are elementary consequences requiring proof from the prior semiaxis formula; their novelty is qualified and no general ellipsoid formula is asserted as new.
title: Strict monotonicity and dimensional scaling of enclosing-ellipsoid excess volume for Euclidean ball caps
